clearance_status: Temporary authoring clearance chosen by assistant; not an original gameplay/phase separation value.
calculation: dx = max(Phase1 foreground maxX, Phase1 PP maxX) + clearance - Phase2 foreground minX; no rotation/scale change.

phase2_sun.label: SP_BP_Phase2_Sun
phase2_sun.intensity_status: Retained native sun intensity, not an original serialized Intensity.

environment_boundary: Bounded PP, source local lights, and channel-separated direct sun; sky/height fog/indirect GI are shared. Existing Pawn lighting channels are not changed.

collision_floor_derivation.selection: The single retained floor tile whose XY bounds contain the Phase1 primary arena reference; raised entrance/stair tiles are excluded.
collision_floor_derivation.formula: XY footprint = retained phase water actor world bounds; topZ = native Phase1 floor tile maxZ; thickness = tile maxZ-minZ; centerZ=topZ-thickness/2; scale=dimensions/engine cube dimensions.
collision_floor_derivation.status: Native authoring support approximation. Applying the Phase1 flat floor height to the Phase2 blood-water core is an explicit authoring assumption, not original collision metadata. No original actor collision mode is replaced.
